name: Claí Bán

tagline.en: A welcoming B&B on Inis Mór, five minutes from the harbour, with views over Galway Bay to the Clare coast.
tagline.ga: B&B fáilteach ar Inis Mór, cúig nóiméad ón gcé, le radharc thar Chuan na Gaillimhe go cósta an Chláir.

address: Kilronan, Inis Mór, Aran Islands, Co. Galway
mapQuery: Claí Bán B&B, Inis Mór, Aran Islands

en: Claí Bán is a B&B on Inis Mór, about five minutes’ walk from the harbour, with views over Galway Bay and across to the Clare coast.

Bartley’s welcome is what guests remember most, along with Porter, the house dog. The en-suite rooms are lovely, and breakfast is a full Irish cooked to order, served in a breakfast room full of antiques from the island.
ga: Is B&B é Claí Bán ar Inis Mór, thart ar chúig nóiméad siúil ón gcé, le radharc thar Chuan na Gaillimhe agus trasna go cósta an Chláir.

Is í fáilte Bartley is mó a fhanann i gcuimhne na n-aíonna, chomh maith le Porter, madra an tí. Tá na seomraí en-suite go hálainn, agus is bricfeasta Éireannach é a chócaráiltear ar ordú, i seomra bricfeasta lán le seandachtaí ón oileán.
